        end = node.end_mark.index
        value = loader.construct_sequence(node)
        return ListToken(value, start, end - 1, content=str_content)

        start = node.start_mark.index
        end = node.end_mark.index
        mapping = loader.construct_mapping(node)
        return DictToken(mapping, start, end - 1, content=str_content)

    def construct_sequence(loader: 'yaml.Loader', node: 'yaml.Node') -> ListToken:
        start = node.start_mark.index
        end = node.end_mark.index
        value = loader.construct_sequence(node)
        return ListToken(value, start, end - 1, content=str_content)

from typesystem.tokenize.positional_validation import ValidationError
from typesystem.tokenize import tokenize_yaml


class Person(Schema):
    name = fields.String()
    age = fields.Integer()


def _unpack(result):
    # validate_yaml may return either a (value, error) two-tuple or the
    # bare value, depending on the typesystem version; handle both.
    if isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2:
        return result
    return result, None


def test_validate_yaml_asserts_pyyaml_installed(monkeypatch):
    import typesystem.tokenize.tokenize_yaml as module

    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "yaml", None)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="'pyyaml' must be installed."):
        module.validate_yaml("name: foo\nage: 1", Person)


def test_validate_yaml_valid_string():
    from typesystem.tokenize.tokenize_yaml import validate_yaml

    result = validate_yaml("name: foo\nage: 1", Person)
    value, error = _unpack(result)
    assert dict(value) == {"name": "foo", "age": 1}
    assert error is None


def test_validate_yaml_valid_bytes():
    from typesystem.tokenize.tokenize_yaml import validate_yaml

    result = validate_yaml(b"name: foo\nage: 1", Person)
    value, error = _unpack(result)
    assert dict(value) == {"name": "foo", "age": 1}
    assert error is None


def test_validate_yaml_validation_error_has_positions():
    from typesystem.tokenize.tokenize_yaml import validate_yaml

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
        validate_yaml("name: foo\nage: not_an_int", Person)

    messages = exc_info.value.messages()
    assert messages, "expected at least one validation message"
    message = messages[0]
    assert message.text  # a human-readable message exists
    assert message.start_position is not None
    assert message.start_position.line_index == 1  # error on the 'age' line
